notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving performs no remote metadata collection and stores no favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are inserted as new rows without detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as ordinary substrings including the quote characters.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot target the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed to creation date descending and no sort-key control exists.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot facility exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or archive action exists.
REF-BM-27: Delete exists, but there is no distinct reversible archive operation.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and saved filter combinations are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
